# NEXT IAS

> India's premier UPSC coaching institute offering comprehensive civil services exam preparation through classroom courses, test series, and expert faculty guidance across multiple centers.

NEXT IAS is a MADE EASY Group initiative providing integrated UPSC CSE preparation programs with a focus on foundation courses, current affairs, and specialized modules. The institute operates multiple centers including Delhi's Mukherjee Nagar, Jaipur, and Prayagraj, serving both Hindi and English medium students.

## Key Topics

- UPSC Civil Services Exam
- IAS Preparation
- UPSC Coaching
- Foundation Courses
- Test Series
- CSAT Module
- Current Affairs
- Prelims & Mains
- Ethics & Essay Writing
- State PSC Exams
- Classroom Courses
- Online Learning
- Mock Tests
- Answer Writing Practice
- Expert Faculty

## Core Programs & Courses

- [GS Foundation Course Pre cum Mains Program for UPSC CSE 2026-27](https://www.nextias.com/classroom-courses/foundation-course-gs): GS foundation 1-year program offline/online for UPSC 2026-27
- [FIRST STEP - NCERT Foundation Course for UPSC Civil Services 2026-27](https://www.nextias.com/classroom-courses/first-step): 12-month NCERT foundation course for UPSC CSE
- [UPSC Advanced Integrated Mentorship Program (AIM) for UPSC 2026](https://www.nextias.com/aim-program): AIM advanced mentorship program for UPSC CSE 2026 preparation
- [UPSC CSAT Course Program for UPSC 2026-27](https://www.nextias.com/classroom-courses/csat-course-prelims): CSAT foundation course for UPSC GS Paper II prelims preparation
- [Current Affairs Value Addition (CA-VA) Course Program for UPSC CSE](https://www.nextias.com/classroom-courses/ca-va-program): CA-VA current affairs course by Dipin Damodaran for UPSC mains
- [UPSC Ethics Course Module for Civil Services Exam 2026](https://www.nextias.com/classroom-courses/ethics-enhancer-course): Ethics Enhancer course for UPSC GS Paper IV (Essay) preparation
- [UPSC CSE 2026 General Studies Courses](https://www.nextias.com/foundation-courses): NEXT IAS GS foundation courses for UPSC CSE 2026 preparation

## Test Series & Mock Exams

- [ANUBHAV Prelims 2026 - All India Open Mock Tests for UPSC CSE](https://www.nextias.com/test-series/anubhav-prelims): ANUBHAV Prelims 2026 all-India open mock test series for UPSC
- [AANKALAN UPPCS Mains 2025 - All India Open Mock Test](https://www.nextias.com/aakalan-uppcs-mains): AANKALAN UPPCS Mains 2025 mock test series by NEXT IAS
